---
title: "Breast imaging datasets"
order: 1
---

This page lists the breast imaging datasets that we keep locally. Each entry
gives the source, the size of our copy, and the labels that it has. The
counts are for our copy, which can be a subset of the published dataset.

| Dataset | Images | Source | Labels |
|---|---|---|---|
| EMBED (subset) | 27,438 | Emory University, USA | Density, BI-RADS, pathology, lesion boxes |
| VinDr-Mammo | 20,000 | Two hospitals, Vietnam | Density, BI-RADS, finding boxes |
| M-SYNTH | 14,760 | FDA VICTRE simulation | Density, lesion truth and position |
| CMMD | 5,202 | China | Benign or malignant, molecular subtype |
| TOMPEI-CMMD | 1,385 annotations | Annotations for CMMD | Lesion outlines |
| CBIS-DDSM (mass) | 1,592 | Scanned film, USA | BI-RADS, pathology, mass masks |
| CDD-CESM | 1,004 | Egypt | BI-RADS, lesion outlines, reports |
| DMID | 510 | India | Lesion masks, reports |
| INbreast | 412 | Porto, Portugal | Density, BI-RADS, lesion outlines |

## EMBED

The Emory Breast Imaging Dataset (Jeong et al. 2023) contains real
screening and diagnostic mammograms. We have a subset of the open release,
because the full release is 2.4 TiB. The subset has two parts:

- Screening exams with the 4 standard views, from one Hologic device model,
  with one exam for each patient. Each BI-RADS density has up to 1,500
  exams.
- All 2D images that have a radiologist lesion box.

Access needs a data use agreement. The images are lossless DICOM.

## VinDr-Mammo

VinDr-Mammo (Nguyen et al. 2023) contains 5,000 four-view exams from
Vietnam. Each breast has a BI-RADS assessment and a density category.
Radiologists drew boxes on the findings. The images come from Siemens,
Planmed and IMS devices. Our copy is lossless DICOM.

## M-SYNTH

M-SYNTH (Sizikova et al. 2023) contains synthetic mammograms that the FDA
VICTRE pipeline makes. The breast density, the lesion density, the lesion
size and the dose are known for each image. The lesion position and the
lesion mask are also known. A smaller subset gives the stimuli for the AI
timing experiment.

## CMMD and TOMPEI-CMMD

The Chinese Mammography Database (CMMD) contains mammograms from 1,775
patients. Each case is benign or malignant, and some cases have a
molecular subtype. TOMPEI-CMMD is a separate release of lesion outlines for
the CMMD images.

## CBIS-DDSM

CBIS-DDSM is a curated subset of DDSM, which contains scanned film
mammograms. We have the mass cases only. Each mass has a region of interest
(ROI) mask, a BI-RADS assessment and a pathology result.

## CDD-CESM

CDD-CESM contains contrast-enhanced spectral mammography from Egypt. We
keep the low-energy images only, because they look like standard
mammograms. The dataset has hand-drawn lesion outlines and radiology
reports.

## DMID

The Digital Mammography Dataset for Breast Cancer Diagnosis Research (DMID)
comes from India. It has region of interest (ROI) masks, pixel-level lesion
annotations and radiology reports.

## INbreast

INbreast contains full-field digital mammograms from Porto. Each image has
an ACR density and a BI-RADS assessment. Lesions and the pectoral muscle
have outlines. The dataset includes the medical reports.
